en.question:
While <<17625>> is on my field, I activate <<11409>> and Special Summon a monster from my Graveyard.
What Type is that Special Summoned monster on my field?
en.title: If I activate <<11409>> while <<17625>> is applying, what happens to the Special Summoned monster's Type?
